frameworks.label: WordPress + WooCommerce
frameworks.heading: Accept Bitcoin & Stablecoin Payments With WordPress + WooCommerce
frameworks.requires: WordPress ≥ 6.6, WooCommerce ≥ 9, PHP ≥ 8.2, GMP and sodium

capabilities.runtime: WordPress 7.1 with WooCommerce, on PHP 8.2
capabilities.databases: MySQL 8, WordPress's own database
capabilities.secrets: The plugin's settings, encrypted with keys derived from WordPress's auth keys, or OPENRECEIVE_NWC_URI in wp-config.php
capabilities.refunds: Refund a settled Lightning payment from your own wallet: the wallet code is receive-only. A payer reclaims a swap deposit that never converted from the order's pay link.
capabilities.mobile: No app SDK. Payers pay on the store's web checkout, and an app that opens it follows the same app store rules as any web checkout.

platforms.label: Vercel
platforms.summary: Next.js on Vercel with a Neon database. Deploy the starter, or add checkout to your own app.
platforms.database: Neon Postgres, through its pooled URL
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job

platforms.label: v0
platforms.summary: v0 builds Next.js apps on Vercel. Paste one prompt and v0 adds checkout to your app.
platforms.database: Neon Postgres, installed from the v0 chat or its Integrations
platforms.secrets: Vercel project environment variables; v0's settings link to them
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job
platforms.prompt:
Add Bitcoin Lightning checkout to this app with OpenReceive. Download the directions with your terminal and follow them exactly:

curl -fsSL https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/next/full.md

NWC_URI and LSC_URI_PRIMARY are already set as this project's environment variables, so do not ask me for them. Store payments in the Neon database: a pg Pool on DATABASE_URL for the app, and DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED to create the tables. Use @openreceive packages 0.4.19 or newer.

platforms.label: Replit
platforms.summary: Replit Agent builds Express apps with a built-in Postgres database. Paste one prompt and Agent adds checkout to your app.
platforms.secrets: Replit Secrets, which publishing links to the published app
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job, so Autoscale fits
platforms.prompt:
Add Bitcoin Lightning checkout to this app with OpenReceive. Download the directions with your terminal and follow them exactly:

curl -fsSL https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/node/full.md

NWC_URI and LSC_URI_PRIMARY are already set as this app's Secrets, and the server reads them from process.env. Do not ask me for them, and do not look for them, check them or print them. Mount the payment routes on the Express server and store payments in this app's Postgres database, through DATABASE_URL. Create OpenReceive's tables when the server starts (the schema SQL is idempotent), because a published Replit app gets its own production database. Use @openreceive packages 0.4.19 or newer.

platforms.label: Lovable
platforms.summary: Lovable builds TanStack Start apps on Cloudflare Workers, with Supabase. Save your wallet code as a secret, paste one prompt, and Lovable adds checkout to your app.
platforms.database: Lovable Cloud's Supabase, or your own connected project, over Supabase's HTTPS API
platforms.secrets: Lovable Cloud secrets; Lovable gives server code the Supabase URL and key
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job
platforms.prompt: Add Bitcoin Lightning checkout to this app with OpenReceive. Fetch https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/lovable/full.md and follow it exactly: it has the migration, the server route and the checkout page. NWC_URI and LSC_URI_PRIMARY are already saved as this project's secrets, so do not ask me for them. Use @openreceive packages 0.4.24 or newer.

platforms.label: Bolt
platforms.summary: Bolt builds Vite React apps on Bolt Cloud, with Bolt Database and server functions. Save your wallet code as a secret, paste one prompt, and Bolt adds checkout to your app.
platforms.database: Bolt Database, or your connected Supabase project, over Supabase's HTTPS API from a server function
platforms.secrets: Bolt's Secrets, read by server functions; Supabase gives each function its URL and service role key
platforms.settlement: On checkout requests to the server function, with no worker or cron job
platforms.prompt: Add Bitcoin Lightning checkout to this app with OpenReceive. Fetch https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/bolt/full.md and follow it exactly: it has the migrations, the server function and the checkout page. NWC_URI and LSC_URI_PRIMARY are already saved as this project's secrets, so do not ask me for them. Use @openreceive packages 0.4.27 or newer.

platforms.label: Supabase
platforms.summary: Store payments in your Supabase Postgres, through its pooled connection or, from Cloudflare Workers, over its HTTPS API.
platforms.database: Your Supabase project's Postgres, through its transaction pooler; from Cloudflare Workers, over its HTTPS API
platforms.secrets: Your server's environment or .env file, as your framework's quickstart says
platforms.settlement: On page requests, with no worker or cron job
